text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Believing that if she can grow just one 
step further at this summer training camp, 
she can even beat the older generation, 
Meisho Doto presses on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, noticing her growth rate had 
slowed, the Trainer's expression grew 
somber. Would they be able to break 
through the ceiling that had begun to 
emerge?
